def factor_volume_momentum_volregime_gate(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    momentum = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(20) - 1
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    gate = np.where(is_high_vol > 0, 1.2, np.where(is_low_vol > 0, 0.7, 1.0))
    df_copy["factor_volume_momentum_volregime_gate"] = momentum * vol_ratio * gate
    return df_copy["factor_volume_momentum_volregime_gate"]
description: Mutation of volume-amplified momentum with compression gate. The parent's range compression gate is replaced by a volume-regime gate using the active alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime. The core mechanism remains volume-amplified momentum: 20-day price momentum multiplied by volume/EMA ratio. The volume-regime gate amplifies signals on high-volume days (1.2x) and dampens on low-volume days (0.7x), filtering noise and focusing on conviction moves. This simplification reduces complexity and targets improved rank stability (RankICIR) by emphasizing trades when volume supports the momentum signal.
